description: Implementation of GzipSourceStream class for handling gzip and deflate streams, including header detection, decompression, and stream state management.

classes.name: GzipSourceStream
classes.description: A stream class for decompressing gzip or deflate data, handling headers, footers, and stream states.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a GzipSourceStream instance with initialization.

methods.name: GzipSourceStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with upstream source and type.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the zlib stream for decompression based on stream type.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the stream type (GZIP or DEFLATE).

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Processes input data, decompresses it, manages stream states, and outputs decompressed data.

methods.name: InsertZlibHeader
methods.description: Attempts to insert a zlib header into the stream if missing.
